newsitem.title: UK: INSTANT VIEW - Windfall tax in British budget.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Windfall tax in British budget.

text.p: Following is a selection of analysts' comments on UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown's plans for a "windfall" tax on privatised utilities announced in the budget statement on Wednesday.
DEBORAH READ, ECONOMIC ADVISER AT BANK OF AMERICA

"Considering that people were looking for windfall utilities alone to give a tightening of three to five billion (stg)... the amount that he announced for 97-98 of five and a half billion (stg) is disappointing from the gilts point of view. They are probably looking for a higher level than that including the windfall tax. Although, looking at the gilt level, we have not seen much movement coming through so they are probably wanting to see what the details are."
